composition.story: factorial(3) calls itself with a smaller n. Each call adds a frame to the call stack and waits. The base case, n = 1, returns 1 without calling again. Then the frames return and multiply, giving 6.

aha.observation: The base case returns 1 without another call. The stack stops growing at three frames, so the waiting frames can finally return.

controls.label: Step
controls.presentation: Previous and Next buttons over the six states; keyboard operable, names kept when disabled at the ends

controls.label: Reset
controls.presentation: Returns to the first state, call factorial(3)

states.label: Call fact(3)
states.sentence: fact(3) starts. Its n is not 1, so it must call fact(2) and wait.
states.why: The first frame goes on the stack.

states.label: Call fact(2)
states.sentence: fact(2) is pushed on top. It also isn't the base case, so it calls fact(1).
states.why: Each call stacks a smaller problem above a waiting frame.

states.label: Call fact(1)
states.sentence: fact(1) is pushed on top. Now the base-case test is checked.
states.why: The stack has grown to its deepest point.

states.label: Base case hit
states.sentence: n is 1, so the base case returns 1 immediately. No fourth call is made.
states.why: Without this stop, the calls would never end.

states.label: fact(2) resumes
states.sentence: fact(1) is popped. fact(2) resumes, multiplies 2 × 1, and returns 2.
states.why: The stack unwinds from the top down.

states.label: fact(3) returns
states.sentence: fact(2) is popped. fact(3) multiplies 3 × 2 and returns 6. The stack is empty.
states.why: Every waiting frame has now finished.
